# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 44 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_044_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 44

**1** Jesus said: "Whoever blasphemes against the Father will be forgiven, and whoever blasphemes against the Son will be forgiven.

**2** But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either on earth or in heaven."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- The triple differentiation is unique to Thomas; the Synoptics distinguish only Son of Man vs. Holy Spirit
- "Will not be forgiven either on earth or in heaven" — the double negation emphasizes the totality of the unforgivability
- The Holy Spirit in Thomas may represent the divine wisdom/gnosis; blasphemy against it = ultimate rejection of the inner light
